verdict.rationale: Daytona docs confirm snapshots capture filesystem and, for VM sandboxes, memory state ('hot snapshots'), enabling pause/resume with state intact, while container sandboxes only get filesystem-only 'cold snapshots'. There's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming actual pause/resume behavior in practice or performance at scale. missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of resume fidelity, explicit pause/resume API documentation (vs. snapshot creation), and confirmation that memory state persistence works reliably outside VM-only sandboxes.
